en.headline: Spanish restaurant Lola María opens second branch on Gresson Street in Wan Chai
en.dek: Chef Edgard Sanuy Barahona’s new outlet began service on 3 November, adding Wan Chai-exclusive dishes alongside the Sheung Wan original’s menu.
body: Lola María, the Spanish restaurant founded by chef Edgard Sanuy Barahona, opened its second Hong Kong branch on Gresson Street in Wan Chai on 3 November. The venue is located at Shop A on the ground floor of Wai Cheong Building at 5-9A Gresson Street.

The new branch follows the original on Hollywood Road in Sheung Wan. It serves lunch, dinner and weekend brunch, with weekday lunch hours from noon to 3pm and weekend or holiday lunch from noon to 4pm. Dinner runs from 6pm to 11pm daily.

The menu retains signature items from the first location while adding Wan Chai-exclusive plates. These include a broken egg with chorizo and potato foam priced around HK$65, a creamy lobster rice around HK$350 to HK$388, and a Gresson Street fruit and cocktail salad at about HK$105 that uses produce from the nearby market. The restaurant also offers pintxos, cured meats, seafood, fideuà and vegetarian options.
The organisers said the space is designed for a more relaxed atmosphere than the original while keeping the same approach that pairs traditional Spanish cooking with contemporary touches.

zh.headline: 西班牙餐廳Lola María於灣仔機利臣街開設第二分店
zh.dek: 主廚Edgard Sanuy Barahona的新店於11月3日開始營業，在上環原店菜式以外加入灣仔限定菜式。
body: 由主廚Edgard Sanuy Barahona創立的西班牙餐廳Lola María，於11月3日在灣仔機利臣街開設第二間分店。店址位於機利臣街5至9A號維昌大廈地下A舖。
新店緊接上環荷李活道原店之後開業，提供午餐、晚餐及週末早午餐。平日午餐時間為中午12時至下午3時，週末及公眾假期午餐則由中午12時至下午4時，晚餐則每日晚上6時至11時。
菜單保留首店的招牌菜式，同時加入灣仔限定菜式，包括西班牙辣肉腸薯仔泡沫配流心蛋（約港幣65元）、龍蝦飯（約港幣350至388元），以及以附近街市食材製作的機利臣街水果鵬尾酒沙律（約港幣105元）。店內亦有西班牙小食、風乾醒肉、海鮮、西班牙海鮮麵及素食選擇。
主理人表示，新店空間較原店更為輕鬆，同時維持傳統西班牙烹飪與現代手法結合的風格。
修正：中文版本中「水果鵬尾酒沙律」及「風乾醒肉」之用字已修正。
